message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
permissions: read-all
name: test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "*"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "*"
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 5"

jobs:
  rubocop:
    name: RuboCop
    timeout-minutes: 30
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@b3aaceaef7e0ee231b499e7b5f49c03fc1d32199 # v1.338.0
        with:
          ruby-version: ruby
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop
  test:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} - Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby }} - ${{ matrix.gemfile }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
        ruby:
          - "3.2"
          - "3.3"
          - "3.4"
          - "4.0"
        gemfile:
          - gemfiles/standalone.gemfile
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            ruby: "2.5"
            gemfile: gemfiles/standalone.gemfile
            experimental: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            ruby: "2.6"
            gemfile: gemfiles/standalone.gemfile
            experimental: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            ruby: "2.7"
            gemfile: gemfiles/standalone.gemfile
            experimental: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            ruby: "3.0"
            gemfile: gemfiles/standalone.gemfile
            experimental: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            ruby: "3.1"
            gemfile: gemfiles/standalone.gemfile
            experimental: false
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            ruby: "2.5"
            gemfile: gemfiles/openssl.gemfile
            experimental: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            ruby: "truffleruby-head"
            gemfile: "gemfiles/standalone.gemfile"
            experimental: true
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            ruby: head
            gemfile: gemfiles/standalone.gemfile
            experimental: true
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    env:
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: ${{ matrix.gemfile }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@b3aaceaef7e0ee231b499e7b5f49c03fc1d32199 # v1.338.0
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: vendor/bundle
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.gemfile }}-${{ hashFiles(matrix.gemfile) }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.gemfile }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-

      - name: Run tests
        run: bundle exec rspec

      - name: Sanitize gemfile path
        run: echo "SANITIZED_GEMFILE=${{ matrix.gemfile }}" | tr '/' '-' >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Upload test coverage folder for later reporting
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ env.SANITIZED_GEMFILE }}
          path: coverage/*.json
          retention-days: 1

  coverage:
    name: Report coverage to Qlty
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: success()
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download coverage reports from the test job
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2

      - uses: qltysh/qlty-action/coverage@ebcd284bf32e36a030afe15f1e136c7be08b9506 # v2.5.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.QLTY_COVERAGE_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage-*/*.json

  smoke:
    name: Built GEM smoke test
    timeout-minutes: 30
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@b3aaceaef7e0ee231b499e7b5f49c03fc1d32199 # v1.338.0
        with:
          ruby-version: ruby
      - name: Build GEM
        run: gem build
      - name: Install built GEM
        run: gem install jwt-*.gem
      - name: Run test
        run: bin/smoke.rb
",
  "rationale": "The workflow's test job uses a large matrix of Ruby versions and gemfiles. Evidence from experiment batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2 (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) shows that adding an explicit actions/cache step for vendor/bundle with a key that includes the gemfile hash yields a 10.5% elapsed time reduction, even when ruby/setup-ruby's bundler-cache is already enabled. The test job matches the experiment's structure (matrix over ruby and gemfile), so adding the same cache step after 'Set up Ruby' is a safe, evidence-backed optimization that preserves all test coverage and does not introduce new permissions or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2"]
}
